items.difficulty_reason: Explicit computation of H^i(B, K ⊗ F) for K = Rf_*(E ⊗ G): untangles the derived pullback in three steps (variant-derived-pullback, flatness of G^n over f^{-1}O_B, definition of pullbacks), runs the H^i chain via Leray and lemma-cohomology-base-change, and states the boundary-map compatibility with the distinguished triangles of the ses of complexes (exact by flatness); the formal commutativity verification of the displayed diagram is omitted by the author and flagged in the notes as non-load-bearing bookkeeping.
